items.title: Talk to the 4 marked students at the school gate
items.detail:
Then open Menu > Intelligence Bookmarks (3rd tab), pick the Nagumohara Junior High result and check all four entries. Kick every Loot Football you pass: blue = common, gold = rare.

[▶ Watch this chapter from the start](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YZxPOUNh9Ls&t=96s)

items.title: Go to homeroom 1-A
items.detail: Enter by the south front door. Beat the Bodybuilding Club member (rock-paper-scissors battle), take the optional red-icon battle inside for the Finishing Blow tutorial, then go upstairs to the west wing and talk to the teacher.

items.title: Beat Kisoji, then head home via Downtown
Side quest: The Fake Cop of Nagumohara
items.detail: Policeman outside Nagumohara Hospital. The fake cop is at the Seaside Park entrance; beat him, then report to the kindly cop nearby. Reward: 30 EXP + cards.

items.title: Follow the waypoint in Seaside Park
Ask 8 people about Sakurazaki at school
items.detail: Spread over the hallway, east wing, ground floor (teacher by the pillar, behind the stairs, both alcoves) and two outside (behind the east wing, west of the main building). Then check Intelligence Bookmarks.

items.title: Side quest: Miss Kasumisaki's Lost Property
items.detail: Teacher by the pillar on the ground floor. Try the Gym Storage door outside to find the Strange Mascot Plushie, then return to her.

items.title: Side quest: Top Secret Dangerous Treasure
items.detail: Student pacing by the east staircase. Keepsakes: next to the bench on 2F, 2F east wing, behind the ground-floor stairs. Reward: 40 EXP + cards.

items.title: Leave school at sunset and talk to the student on School Road
Find Josephine the cat in the playground
items.detail: The Cat Lady blocks the road until you do. Beat the cat in battle.

items.title: Side quest: Leader of the Boys' lost football
items.detail: Accept in the playground. The ball is at the side-quest marker to the west; beat the Irritable Boy. Reward: 30 EXP + cards.

items.title: Photograph and beat the Kraken on the Rural Road railway
items.detail: Left on the D-pad opens camera mode. Unlocks the first story achievement.

items.title: Side quest: Why Grandma Got Lost: Part 1
items.detail: Wayward Grandma on Nagumo Street. Beat her, walk her to Downtown, use the glowing spot on your right.

items.title: Side quest: Why Grandma Got Lost: Part 2
items.detail: Talk to her again in Downtown and take her back to School Road.

items.title: Head home, post in Inacord, look for a club room
items.detail: Follow the waypoints through the remaining 'Make your way back home' objectives.

items.title: Chase the Kraken a second time to finish the chapter
Side quest: Why Grandma Got Lost: Part 3
items.detail: Grandma is at the School Road playground right at the start. Beat her, fast travel to Nagumohara Hospital, use the glowing spot at the entrance. Reward: 40 EXP + 4 cards.

items.title: Go to Seaside Park (fast travel)
items.detail:
Play the scramble mini-game, then use the glowing spot by the bench.

[▶ Watch this chapter from the start](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YZxPOUNh9Ls&t=3872s)

items.title: Complete all Match Simulation drills with Momochi
Go to the Old Gym Storage, then the Dance Club room
Try to scout Kodokai
items.detail: He is on floor 2F by the glass door. Then go back to the Dance Club room.

items.title: Ask 6 people about Raika
items.detail: Two inside the Dance Club room, four around it. Then check Intelligence Bookmarks.

items.title: Eat at the noodle shop Downtown (as Joji and Kisoji)
items.detail: Eating mini-game, same rock-paper-scissors idea as battles.

items.title: Shop for boots and accessories in the Shopping District
items.detail: Two shops on the way to the Back-Alley Plaza. First chance to buy stat gear.

items.title: 5-a-side vs the Shopkeepers (Back-Alley Field)
items.detail:
Follow the objectives on the left: get Sakurazaki into the goal area and shoot, start a Focus Battle with Kisoji, then win. If your AT is below the keeper's KP, use a Special Move (Bounce Shot) or keep shooting to drain KP.

[▶ Watch this match](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YZxPOUNh9Ls&t=6625s)

items.title: Go to Hillview Terrace and win the battle as Joji
Save, then do the dance-off with Raika
items.detail: Rhythm mini-game: press when the ring meets the circle. Losing seems to be scripted and has no effect.

items.title: Check Inacord, then go to Cafe Tank on Nagumo Street
items.detail: [▶ Watch this chapter from the start](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YZxPOUNh9Ls&t=8067s)

items.title: Gather info at school, then train with Joji
Gather info on School Road, then train with Raika
items.detail: Dribble between checkpoints, avoid the krakens.

items.title: Gather info Downtown, then train with Kisoji
Gather info at school again, then train with Kodokai
items.detail: Give him a pep talk whenever his mind wanders.

items.title: Go to the Archive (3F, last room)
Go to Cafe Tank and talk to Makino
Find Machi on the Seaside Park shoreline
Side quest: The Elusive Prize
items.detail: Gloomy Man Downtown. Collect all the Raffle Tickets around the area and return. Rewards include Zealot's Boots.

items.title: Side quest: Unable to Attend the Reunion
items.detail: NPC by the railway on Rural Road, then the food shop in the Downtown shopping street. Reward: Rebel Sunglasses, 2 Finesse Beans.

items.title: Side quest: Show Me the Best Spots
items.detail: InaTuber by the pillar at Nagumohara Station (you pass him on the way to the Old Shipyard). Start at Seaside Park and follow the glowing spots.

items.title: Side quest: Josephine's Elegant Stroll: Part 1
Side quest: PsyRanger Makes an Entrance
POINT OF NO RETURN: enter the Old Shipyard warehouse
items.detail: Unfinished Chapter 3 side quests are lost after this. Beat The Tumblers.

items.title: Go to Seaside Park and take the team photo
items.detail: Left on the D-pad.

items.title: 5-a-side vs Seagull FC
items.detail:
Talk to the man in the mauve floral shirt. Keeper has about 162 KP: one Special Move from Joji or two normal shots scores.

items.title: Buy and equip the Keyman Lockdown tactic
items.detail: The game does not tell you to buy it: Special Training Booth (stickman by the pitch) > second-to-last tab. Then Team Dock > Football Battle > empty Tactics slot.

items.title: Match vs the Baseball Club
items.detail:
Keeper has 227 KP. Your first shot is always saved and Yagyu scores. Then use Keyman Lockdown when prompted (L1/LB + shown button) and shoot freely.

items.title: Side quest: In-Depth Coverage
items.detail: NPC on 3F. Can only be finished in the training phase: start Hecaton Stairway training with this quest selected. Reward: Power Pendant, beans.

items.title: Side quest: Coying Up to Sasanami
items.detail: NPC on 2F. Three document sets: classroom opposite him, a northern room on 2F, north of 3F. Hand in at the blue spot on the ground floor. Reward: Fiery Keychain.

items.title: Side quest: Join Me for Art Training
items.detail: Northwest of campus, after the merger talk with Miss Kasumisaki. Reward: Colorful Choker.

Run the entry trials and pick 5 new members
items.detail: Scramble against each group (Kisoji, Shisendo, Momochi). Suggested picks: 2 defenders + 3 midfielders.

items.title: Check on teammates, find Kameo behind the school, go to the Staff Room
Training goals: Team AT 1100 / DF 1050
items.detail: Claim Activities rewards (Menu > Data Files > Activities) for EXP Orbs and spend them on Joji and Raika.

items.title: Sakurazaki learns Force Flash, Raika learns Spin Shot
items.detail: Usually already learned. If not: Team Dock > player > equip beans, then train or play friendlies.

items.title: Friendly vs Twinford Junior High
items.detail: Easy if Joji and Raika are levelled. Gives the First Victory achievement.

items.title: Match vs West Manor Academy
items.detail:
First half is scripted: you cannot stop Haru Endo, do not waste effort. Second half you need more than 465 AT to score: Joji's Special Moves, repeated shots, or a Shot Chain. After you score, tackle the ball carrier straight from their kick-off.

Friendly vs Northbright (cannot be won)
items.detail:
Their keeper never runs out of KP. A draw is the best possible result, so do not burn time here.

items.title: Side quest: The Return of Doll and Finn
items.detail: Old man at the dolphin statue in Seaside Park, then show him training at the Old Shipyard. Reward: Dragon Keychain.

items.title: Side quest: Picture Perfect: Yagyu's Finest
items.detail: Yagyu Superfan outside the baseball field. Start a friendly vs Twinford, press Down (Commander Mode) then Left to photograph Yagyu. Return and win the battle. Reward: Smooth Boots.

items.title: Side quest: Magnetic Field Encounters
items.detail: Mujuriki north of the school building; visit the three map spots. Reward: Prayer Bracelet.

items.title: Side quest: The Perfect Shot
items.detail: South of the Nagumohara pitch, then a friendly vs Seagull FC at Cove Beach. Reward: Trendy Bracelet.

items.title: Side quest: The Dark Society Emerges
items.detail: Kids in the School Road playground. Reward: Pact Pendant.

items.title: Perfect Spring Thunderclap (Nagumohara Pitch) and Icy Grace (Baseball Field)
items.detail: Walk to each waypoint and use the glowing spot.

items.title: Match vs Northbright
items.detail:
First half you cannot score; just do the objectives (Focus Battle vs Soramiya, take a shot). After the scene, Keyman Lockdown on Soramiya (hold L1/LB + button). When Unmei says so, get near goal, pass to Sakurazaki and use Spring Thunderclap. After that first goal you can score normally.

[▶ Watch this match](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YZxPOUNh9Ls&t=19153s)

Manager and Skill Showdown (you coach Northbright)

Talk to Shimozuru. You play against your own team, levels are normalised. To make it trivial, strip your team's equipment or wreck their formation first.

items.title: Side quest: My Goddess
items.detail: 8th grader outside the Old Gym Storage. Get the pen from Miss Kasumisaki (ground floor, northwest, first room on the right). Reward: Metal Ring.

items.title: Side quest: Go Viral! Special Football Drill
items.detail: Strict Science Teacher in the same room as Miss Kasumisaki, then the man outside the Old Shipyard warehouse. Reward: Wristband of Victory.

items.detail: Start inside Cafe Tank on Nagumo Street. Reward: Panda Boots.

items.title: Side quest: Don Gorillo Bowl King
Buy Flame Fortress, Invisible Link and Bond Protocol; equip Boost 15
items.detail: Only Boost 15 must be equipped, but equip Flame Fortress too for the match.

items.title: Meet the formation requirements
items.detail: Soramiya and Shinano must start. Give them equipment.

items.title: Match vs Eastwind International
items.detail:
You cannot score in the first half: stay in your own three quarters, pass around to drain their Tension, use Flame Fortress. Expect injuries and substitutions. You can score from 15 minutes into the second half, then go all out.

[▶ Watch this match](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YZxPOUNh9Ls&t=23692s)

Visit the 7 spots at Odaiba Football Gardens
items.detail:
Four in the Lodging Area, three in the Main Area, then check Intelligence Bookmarks.

items.title: Photograph the designated players
items.detail: Three in the Lodging Area (one inside the cottage behind you), then more in the Main Area.

items.title: Return to the Lodging Cottage, then the Skyport helicopter
Side quest: The Missing Rookie
items.detail: East side, north of the football field in the Lodging Area. Follow the waypoints until the glowing spot outside the south field. Reward: Blazing Bangle.

items.title: Side quest: Can You Show Me Around?
items.detail: Near the shopping malls in Odaiba's Main Area. Tour the Lodging Area spots and photograph him by Mamoru Endo's statue. Reward: Princess Mantle.

items.title: Side quest: Where's That Ball?
items.detail: Circular platform in the centre of the Main Area; the ball is northwest in the Lodging Area. Reward: Deluxe Oden Charm.

items.title: Side quest: After-Hours Student Shenanigans
items.detail: Running track in Nagumohara. Talk to students in the far north, on the school terrace and on the Seaside Park beach, then pass time to Night at the Seaside Park statue and talk to the Wayward Grandma. Reward: Ambrosia Replica.

items.title: Side quest: Gunning for Top Keeper
items.detail: Night, School Road playground. Needs a match vs the Shopkeepers at the Back Alley Field, only available in the training phase. Reward: Meteor Necklace.

items.title: Side quest: Josephine's Elegant Stroll: Part 3
items.detail: Night, School Road playground. Beat Josephine, skip to morning, take her to the school, then the Skyport. Reward: Benevolence Bangle.

items.title: Get into the Archive (3F)
items.detail: It is locked: check the two rooms next to it, then talk to the teacher in the ground-floor north wing. Osamu Manbe joins.

items.title: As Kisoji, follow the waypoint to the station in Odaiba
Training goals: Team AT 3650 / DF 3450 + formation requirements
items.detail: Train more than the minimum here; the next match is the hardest so far.

items.title: Scout and recruit your first player
items.detail: Scouting unlocks here. See the scouting guide.

items.title: Match vs Stormridge Junior High
items.detail:
They have unlimited Tension. Defend, keep passing to avoid Focus Battles, and only do one when the objective asks (first any, then vs Yashiro, the long-haired defender with the Keshin aura). They get two scripted goals. Second half: pass to Kisoji, start a Focus Battle, use Proto-Entertainer (hold R1/RB + button), keep feeding Kisoji and score with him.

[▶ Watch this match](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YZxPOUNh9Ls&t=29887s)

items.title: Friendly vs Lawcrest (level 32)
items.detail: Keeper has 1129 KP: chain Special Moves or keep shooting. They steal well, so avoid Focus Battles if you are at or under their level. Level one clean lane (a wing or the centre) rather than everyone.

items.title: Friendly vs Noble Insight
items.detail: Lots of defensive Special Moves. Use long passes to skip midfield, then stack your strongest shot moves. Keeper 1129 KP.

items.title: Friendly vs AI Academy
items.detail:
Same approach as the other two.

[▶ Watch this match](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YZxPOUNh9Ls&t=32472s)

items.title: Training goals: Team AT 4150 / DF 4100 + formation requirements
Buy and set Star Path, Roar of Resolve and Titan Wall
Buy 16 Champon Spikes and equip all starters and bench
Match vs Royal Academy (level 39)
items.detail:
Beatable around level 32. They may get a scripted goal during Enchanted Forest. Answer each of their tactics in order: Star Path, then Roar of Resolve after Caucus Race, then Titan Wall after Cavalry Advance. Their keeper reaches about 1700, so wear him down. Second half, after Alice's 'weak link' scene: Focus Battle as Kameo, then as Yagyu, then Kameo passes to Yagyu for Heavenly Thunder (scripted goal).

[▶ Watch this match](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YZxPOUNh9Ls&t=33355s)

Match vs the Baseball Club team (level 39)
items.detail:
Positions are locked oddly (Raika in goal, Kameo and Shisendo up front). Walk your real forwards up to shoot, or use Yagyu.

[▶ Watch this match](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YZxPOUNh9Ls&t=38167s)

items.title: Training goals: Team AT 5100 / DF 5100 + formation requirements
Give Kameo and Shisendo a Shot Move each
items.detail: On each one's Abilearn Board, follow the green line to the router node and flip it: it opens forward-style slots. Buy shot moves at the Special Training Booth or the Odaiba mall if you have none.

items.title: Final match vs Raimon
items.detail:
1) Let their first goal in, it is scripted; save your moves. 2) Use Stalwart Suppression as soon as it is offered. 3) Score twice without conceding. 4) After half-time Haru Endo scores twice no matter what. 5) When Unmei comes on, use Aether Virtuoso (R1/RB + button) and score. 6) New keeper Mama Sigdale: your first two shots are scripted saves, so use plain shots. 7) Then chain Kameo's and Shisendo's moves for 2000+ AT, with Shisendo taking the final shot.

[▶ Watch this match](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YZxPOUNh9Ls&t=39143s)

guides.title: Start here: how to use your short sessions
guides.body:
## The plan
1. **Story Mode first** (9 chapters, roughly 30 to 35 hours). Finishing it hands your levelled team to every other mode.
2. **Extended Story**: one extra match after the credits.
3. **Chronicle Mode**: seven routes of classic matches, the best place to grow your squad offline.
4. **Online and collection achievements** whenever you feel like it.

## Habits that save time
- Open the map at the start of every session. Blue circles with **!** are side quests; do them before the chapter's training phase ends because many disappear.
- Take every red crossed-swords battle you walk past. They are quick and pay tokens and EXP.
- Kick every Loot Football. Gold ones are rare loot.
- Claim **Menu > Data Files > Activities** now and then: free EXP Orbs.
- Fast travel from the map instead of walking.

## Names
This guide uses the Japanese names (Unmei, Sakurazaki, Raika...). To match, turn on Romaji names in **Options > Gameplay**. The English names differ (for example Unmei Sasanami is Destin Billows).

guides.title: How to win matches
guides.body:
## The one rule
A shot scores when your **total AT** is higher than the keeper's **KP**. Time slows near goal and shows both numbers.

- AT too low? Use a **Special Move**, or **chain** shots between two players (Shot Chain) to add them up.
- Every shot the keeper saves **lowers his KP**. Two or three plain shots often open the door.
- Dribbling past a defender works the same way: your Attack against their Defense.

## Scripted moments
Story matches force certain goals and saves. When the game clearly will not let you score or defend, do not spend Tension. Just complete the objective shown on the left of the screen and wait for the scene.

| Sign | What to do |
|---|---|
| Opponent has an 'Enemy Boost' | Let it happen, save your moves |
| Objective says 'Complete a Focus Battle' | Do exactly one, then go back to passing |
| A tactic prompt appears | Hold L1/LB (tactics) or R1/RB (Keshin and abilities) + the shown button |

## Cheap tricks
- Right after you score, sprint at their ball carrier from kick-off and tackle.
- Against teams that steal a lot, play long passes and avoid Focus Battles.
- You do not need the whole team levelled. One strong lane from your goal to theirs is enough.

guides.title: Training phases
guides.body:
Before most big matches the story stops until you meet a list of goals.

- **Team AT / DF**: train at the training spots, play friendlies, spend EXP Orbs, and equip boots and accessories on everyone.
- **Tactics**: buy them at the **Special Training Booth** (the stickman by the pitch, second-to-last tab), then set them in **Team Dock > Football Battle > Tactics**.
- **Formation requirements**: shown on the Formation screen. Usually named players must start.
- **Moves**: equip beans on the player and play, or flip the router node on their Abilearn Board to open new slots.

Finish side quests **before** you advance out of the training phase.

| Chapter | Team AT | Team DF | Also needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 1100 | 1050 | Force Flash, Spin Shot, friendly vs Twinford |
| 5 | 1500 | 1500 | Spring Thunderclap, Icy Grace, Keyman Lockdown |
| 6 | 2700 | 2700 | Flame Fortress, Invisible Link, Bond Protocol, Boost 15 set |
| 7 | 3650 | 3450 | Proto-Entertainer on Kisoji, recruit 1 player |
| 8 | 4150 | 4100 | Star Path, Roar of Resolve, Titan Wall, 16 Champon Spikes |
| 9 | 5100 | 5100 | Stalwart Suppression, shot moves for Kameo and Shisendo |

guides.title: Scouting players (from Chapter 7)
guides.intro: Unlocks in Chapter 7's training phase. Recruitable students have a four-leaf clover over their head and change with the day and time of day. Ten recruits gives the Builder of Bonds achievement.

steps.title: Talk to the student twice
steps.text: The second conversation reveals their name and the **Give a Gift** option.

steps.title: Read the gift they want
steps.text: It is shown on the right of the screen. Write it down.

steps.title: Buy the gift
steps.text: Every gift is sold in a shop. Check these three until you find it.

steps.title: Give the gift
steps.text: They hand you an item back and leave for a new spot. The dialogue says where; if you miss it, look in **Menu > Data Files** (scouts screen).

steps.title: Meet them at the new spot
steps.text: Complete their Bond Quest or beat them in battle, depending on the student.

steps.title: Recruit
steps.text: Talk to them again and choose Recruit. They go to your player bank.

guides.title: Levelling fast
guides.body:
- **Level difference bonus**: playing teams far above your level pays much more EXP, even if you lose.
- Spend **EXP Orbs** from Activities on your two or three key scorers first.
- Equipment that boosts EXP only helps the player wearing it.
- If you finish the story under level 50, keep levelling the same team in **Chronicle Mode**.

guides.title: Chronicle Mode explained
guides.body:
Chronicle Mode replays the matches of the whole series. It is separate from the story, but it is far easier **after** finishing Story Mode because your levelled team comes with you.

## Each chronicle point has four battles
| Battle | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Chronicle Battle | The canon match with a preset team. Just follow the objectives; many results are scripted. |
| Route Unlock Battle | Played with **your** team. Winning opens the next point. |
| Rare Drop Battle | Farm items and that team's uniform. |
| Hero Battle | Farm spirits. Win as many Focus Battles as possible; each can drop a spirit, with a small chance of Hero rank. |

## Route order
1. Football Frontier
2. Alius (after Football Frontier)
3. Football Frontier International (after Alius)
4. Saint's Way
5. Chrono Stone
6. Galaxy (after Chrono Stone)
7. LBX (needs Chrono Stone and Galaxy; added in an update)

Later updates added more content after these; check the in-game route screen for anything not listed here.

guides.title: Getting new players
guides.body:
- **Spirits** drop from match wins and Chronicle battles. Collect a player's spirit, then summon them. Stronger opponents give better odds of Legendary and above.
- **Player Universe** (Chronicle main menu): spend **Bond Stars** on constellations. Pulls come in sets of 12 for 5 Bond Stars. This is the best source of **Hero** variants. Most of the story cast is in the Victoria constellation once the story is cleared.
- **Bond Stars** mostly come from online matches (win or lose), with smaller amounts from Chronicle.
- **Spirit Market**: trade spare spirits and items for specific spirits, Hyper Moves and some Keshin.
- **Ascension / Spirit Fusion** raises rarity with beans, but stops at Legendary. Hero rank cannot be reached this way.

## Hero variants
| Variant | Team passive type |
|---|---|
| Magma (fire) | Tension or Rough Play |
| Metal | Justice or Bond |
| Crystal (pink) | Counter or Breach |

Same base stats and moves; only the team passive differs.
